contracts.title: Predefinição:Refn
contracts.preservation: The anonymous outer reference body is passed unchanged as parameter 1; its literal group is passed unchanged as group. Named or special-attribute outer references are excluded.

fileAvailability: A file URL is changed only after a source-bound imageinfo receipt confirms the exact filename in the local or shared repository. No on-wiki file or article is edited by the preflight.
conflicts: A competing destination parameter, unknown consumer or ambiguous reference association prevents the local repair. Unsupported fields are not deleted.
